provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: The landing md/shared-typing.md#claim-shared.typing.realization directly introduces shared.typing.realization. Links variable descriptions, storage, structural WF, per-reference realization and table/type WF. Pending pairs are introduced immediately beside the relation that accounts for them. Compared inline notation, displayed rules/equations, and any code/table with the named dependencies. Realizes includes well-formed classes/environment, Admissible pending types, WellFormedWith ownership including pending roots, FieldsMatchClasses even on hidden fields, exact variable domains and per-variable/pending Satisfies. The revised prose explicitly requires normalized as well as well-formed types and keeps shared aliases' views independent. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
